scope: Initial atomic candidates for meta-information grammar, declaration schemas, Number/Type semantics and data types in VCFv4.1–4.5. Does not exhaust all meta-information subtypes or structural-variant ALT definitions.
method: Inspect version-specific source passages, including definitions, examples and footnotes.
Split Number cardinality semantics and value ordering into separate independently testable candidates.
Record the version introduction of R, P, LA/LR/LG and M explicitly.
Keep BCF-driven restrictions labelled as cross-format constraints even when the VCF text explicitly applies them to VCF.
Do not infer absence/invalidity solely from omission from a later reserved-key table.
